quote: To be honest, I didn't want to rate this game at all, but the mobile version of this site doesn't let me cancel the rating -_- so I'm just leaving the highest rating, in line with the majority.
game_title: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time

author: whomscz
quote: If this weren't deceptively branded as GTA, it would be a 6/10. As it stands, I have no other choice. I wanted a GTA game; instead, I got a boring simulation of a depressing real life, featuring an emotionally unstable woman who exploits her man’s blind love.
